mentions.name: Atmos Bedside Lamp
mentions.description: A fully automated bedside lamp that shifts in color and brightness throughout the day to help users prepare for sleep and wake up more naturally, with machine learning features in development that mimic the Nest Learning Thermostat but for lighting.
mentions.source_excerpt: Atmos Bedside Lamp[1]: A fully automated circadian lamp that automatically shifts in color and brightness throughout the day, helping you prepare for sleep and wake up more naturally. Working on some machine learning features that mimic the functionality of the Nest Learning Thermostat, but for lighting. The first units are shipping by Christmas.

mentions.name: Restful Atmos Sleep Lamp
mentions.description: A smart bedside lamp that automatically shifts its light throughout the day and night to support the circadian rhythm, reducing blue light at night and maximizing it during the day. A machine learning layer learns the user's preferences and automatically adjusts light intensity, similar to the Nest Thermostat.
